text: Rockfort Limited (companies-house no. SC553173) holds 75% or more of the shares and voting rights in Rockfort Engineering Limited (SC460884) and has the right to appoint or remove its directors.
short: Rockfort Engineering Ltd is controlled by Rockfort Limited.
